findings.evidence: SOURCE 1 page is headed 'WeirdML v3' and says 'WeirdML (v3) is an agentic benchmark…' with 'Previous versions: WeirdML v2 · WeirdML v1'. Row claims version '2', version_guard 'Verify the published version 2 before reading results.', and status 'active'. findings.evidence: SOURCE 1 states WeirdML v3 has '11 complex hand-made tasks' and that the 'official score is 80% normalized area under its line on a logarithmic token axis, plus 20% of its final value'. Row scoring.metric instead says 'Average Max Accuracy: per task, mean over runs of the maximum test accuracy across the 5 iterations per run, averaged over all 17 tasks'. The 17-task count and Average Max Accuracy scoring rule are not in the protocol; the page's stated task count is 11 and its scoring rule is area-under-curve based.
findings.repair: Replace the metric with the protocol's official scoring definition and correct the task count to 11 (or, if this row is truly for v2, supply the v2 protocol evidence that establishes 17 tasks and Average Max Accuracy; the packet does not provide it).

findings.repair: Set superseded_by to our registry id for the WeirdML v3 successor board, leaving the exact id to be taken from the successor's own registry entry.
